ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: mystic botany
ResearchProjectDef.description: Wild mystic flowers grow across the rim. Learning which ones hold mana, and how to plant them again, is where every Botania colony starts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: mana
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study how certain flowers hold energy in their petals. Grinding them releases mana powder, which can be folded into steel or bound into wood, and stored in a pool of liquid light.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: generating flowers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Flowers that produce mana on their own. The endoflame burns fuel; the daybloom and nightshade simply drink the sun and the dark, then wither once their season is over.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: garden craft
ResearchProjectDef.description: Placeholder: a petal altar for crafting flowers in batches. Content arrives in a later version.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: functional flowers
ResearchProjectDef.description: Placeholder: flowers that work for the colony — growth, hauling and thorns. Content arrives in a later version.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: manasteel
ResearchProjectDef.description: Placeholder: manasteel ingots and the first real gear. Content arrives in a later version.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: mana mending
ResearchProjectDef.description: Placeholder: a bench that repairs gear with mana, and a tower that slowly mends walls and furniture. Content arrives in a later version.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: mana infusion
ResearchProjectDef.description: Placeholder: an infusion table that lets a colony craft high-tier goods out of mana instead of electricity. Content arrives in a later version.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: mana grid
ResearchProjectDef.description: Placeholder: relays with longer reach, bigger pools and a more efficient fluxfield. Content arrives in a later version.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: wand forms
ResearchProjectDef.description: Placeholder: two wand variants (piercing and scattering) plus a cheaper mana cost per shot. Content arrives in a later version.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: alfheim gate
ResearchProjectDef.description: Placeholder: a gate that trades mana for elven materials. Content arrives in a later version.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: elementium
ResearchProjectDef.description: Placeholder: elementium weapons and armour. Content arrives in a later version.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: terrasteel
ResearchProjectDef.description: Placeholder: the terrestrial agglomeration platform, terrasteel and the Gaia ritual. Content arrives in a later version.

ResearchProjectDef.label: botania: gaia
ResearchProjectDef.description: Placeholder: unlocked by a gaia spirit techprint, not by points alone. Content arrives in a later version.
